layout_sources: None found for Landsbankinn: the web search budget for this run was used up and no importer config for it was among the sources fetched.

Icelandic conventions only, from https://github.com/Dagur/ofxstatement-is-arionbanki/blob/HEAD/src/ofxstatement/plugins/arionbanki.py (Arion banki: Dagsetning DD.MM.YYYY, Tilvisun, Skyring, Upphaed with a dot for thousands and a comma decimal)
notes: UNVERIFIED placeholder. Landsbankinn netbanki transaction download assumed as: three labelled rows above the table (account, currency ISK, period) and a blank line, semicolon-separated, Windows-1252 (ð, æ, ó), CRLF, dates DD.MM.YYYY, whole krónur with a dot for thousands ("-245.000"), balance after each line (Staða), newest first. ISK has no minor unit, so the expected amounts are whole krónur. Opening = the oldest Staða minus its amount; closing = the newest Staða.
